startup.note: time from ffmpeg process start to the first -progress block that reports decoded output (video frame count > 0 or output time > 0); blocks are emitted every 100 ms. With --start-attempts > 1 all other figures in this report are those of the last attempt.

progress.note: speed_factor = media seconds output / wall seconds, both counted from the first decoded frame; 1.0 is real time

stalls.note: a stall is a period after the first decoded frame in which the output media time did not advance; resolution 100 ms
